content.comment_body: Hello experts, I've never worked with [product_name] before. I would like to connect [product_name] version [version_no] to a SCADA system developed by [company_name] and an engineering station over Ethernet. Is this feasible? Best regards, [user_name]
If your SCADA software supports TCP/IP communication and is compatible with the S7-200 protocol, then it should be possible.
Hi, You might find the following topic helpful: Application examples for [product_name].
My current system already communicates with S7-200. Is that enough? How can I check if my SCADA can work with [product_name]? Is testing the only way?
Which SCADA software are you using?
It’s a monitoring system. I use Matrikon OPC to connect S7 to SCADA, so now I need to make [product_name] and Matrikon communicate with each other.

If Matrikon OPC can connect to an S7-200, it's likely operating via MPI and not over Ethernet TCP/IP. I’m not familiar with all the capabilities of Matrikon OPC, so I can’t confirm if it will work. Please contact Matrikon directly. If you need to download manuals from Matrikon, you'll be asked for your name and email address. I personally will not provide my data if the manual isn’t intended for me.
I consulted Matrikon support and they confirmed that such communication is not available. Thank you all for your assistance.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are investigating the possibility of integrating [product_name] version [version_no] with a third-party SCADA system via Ethernet, using Matrikon OPC. There is uncertainty regarding protocol compatibility and system integration, particularly between [product_name], Matrikon OPC, and SCADA solutions. Ultimately, users found from vendor support that direct OPC communication between Matrikon and [product_name] version [version_no] is not supported.
analysis.user_expectations: The user intends to connect [product_name] version [version_no] to a SCADA system and engineering station using Ethernet, leveraging Matrikon OPC as a communication interface, similar to how S7-200 systems are integrated.
